rationale: Формат датотеке is natural standard Serbian Cyrillic for File format: формат names the kind/encoding and датотеке is the appropriate genitive. The inherited Име слике means image name and mislabels this control.

This is not a filename field. Source creates a separate Назив датотеке EditText (export_filename), then the save20_file_format caption and export_format Spinner. The same resource supplies the Spinner contentDescription and the vertical-form field label.

The corrected wording applies consistently to visible normal and vertical labels and to the accessibility name without changing application behavior. PNG and JPEG are real available non-derived save formats.
The surrounding ASCII double quotes are Android resource syntax, not intended visible punctuation; isolated AAPT2 compile/link/dump retained the exact display value Формат датотеке.
